'''May 2001 Carmel tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Carmel, Indiana on 30 May 2001. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2397">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-31-carmel-in-5-30-01d2397/ carmel-in-5-30-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 31 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-31-carmel-in-5-30-01d2397/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Carmel, Indiana
